Optimal.Notes: This profile balances visual quality and stability by bumping textures and view distance to Medium while keeping shadows and foliage cheap. The 40 Hz refresh rate pairs well with the 30 fps cap to eliminate judder.

profiles.Summary: Enshrouded is a demanding open-world survival RPG that exceeds the Steam Deck's hardware capabilities at native resolution; it requires low settings and FSR upscaling to reach a playable frame rate. ProtonDB reporters rate it gold, meaning it runs under Proton with some tweaks, but expect performance compromises given the minimum GPU spec (GTX 1060 6GB) already outclasses the Deck's RDNA 2 iGPU.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum requirements (GTX 1060 6GB, which is well above the Deck's GPU) and Deck hardware capabilities. On your first run, check the frame counter in an open outdoor area and during combat — if fps drops below 25 consistently, lower View Distance and Shadow Quality first, or drop to the Max Battery profile.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render at 960x600 and let the Deck's FSR upscale to 1280x800 to relieve GPU pressure. Locking TDP to 8 W keeps heat and fan noise low; accept the occasional dip below 30 fps in foggy or combat-heavy areas.

KnownIssues: Game requires more VRAM than the Deck's shared memory pool can comfortably provide, leading to potential stutters in dense areas or when loading new chunks.
No official Steam Deck (Verified/Playable) status — some UI elements or text may be small and require the Adjustable Text Size accessibility option.
Multiplayer/co-op sessions with many players (up to 16) will significantly increase CPU load and further reduce frame rates.
Shader compilation stutters may occur on first launch or when entering new biomes for the first time.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Removing TDP and GPU clock limits lets the APU boost fully; expect the fan to spin up and battery life to drop significantly. A 40 fps cap at 40 Hz is the realistic ceiling — do not expect a stable 60 fps given the game's minimum spec requirement.

Optimal.Notes: A 40 Hz refresh with a matching 40 fps cap delivers buttery-smooth motion on the OLED panel and is the sweet spot for this game's GPU demands. Medium textures and fog keep the world looking good without tanking performance.
